name: Hikage no Himari - sun in the shade
original_name: 日陰の日葵 - sun in the shade
source:
Hiroyuki Nasukawa, a high school student whose father is a piano tuner, wants to become a respectable adult, but his anxiety about the future keeps him from being a good student at school. Eventually, he cheats on a test, gets caught and the punishment is, to his surprise, a request to repair the school's piano.

[From [url=https://www.shinzoutranslations.com/2023/05/release-sun-in-shade-english.html]Shinzou Translations[/url]]
translation:
高中生那须川ヒロユキ的父亲是一名钢琴调律师。他想成为值得尊敬的大人，却因对未来感到不安，在学校里一直表现不佳。最终，他甚至在考试中作弊，当场被抓。然而，出乎他意料的是，等待他的惩罚竟是一个请求，希望他修好学校的钢琴。

[摘自[url=https://www.shinzoutranslations.com/2023/05/release-sun-in-shade-english.html]Shinzou Translations[/url]]
